title: WMTM | Way More than Minecraft!
description: Trying to make Minecraft more realistic and more harder.
body:
# WMTM
## (Way More than Minecraft v. 1.2)

This mod makes Minecraft hard to beat because just breaking a log with just your hands will damage you.
To simply get a log you need to craft some sticks axes and to reinforce them.

This mod is work-in-progress, more features are coming soon!
